title: 第109章：死也不能说！
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦昭岚皱眉。

看来今日是避免不了冲突了。

不过既然萧寒章要管，那也应该让他明白，他手下做了什么？

“萧将军说张强是你手下的人你不能不插手此事。那好，我倒要问问，你的手下私自看了我的信，还把信烧了。

你身为将军，是不是应该公正一点，让你的属下给我一个交代？”

“什么，张副将居然偷看别人的信啊！”

“张副将为何要怎么样做？难道张副将对她……嘻嘻……”

士兵看向张强，捂嘴偷笑。

他没将话说完，但其他人都听明白了，他是什么意思。

张强眉头一皱，不悦地看向他。

“胡说八道什么，我怎么可能对她有意思？”

“那张副将不妨说说，你为何要偷看秦夫人的信，还把信烧了？”

萧寒章皱眉，脸色沉冷。

他居然不知道，在他的军营里，发生了这种事情。

张强对上他的眼眸，冷哼一声。

“什么信，我不知道，将军莫要相信这个女人的一面之词。”

“怎么，张副将这是敢做不敢认？”

秦昭岚看向他，眼眸里溢满了嘲讽。

她握着手枪的手一转，将枪口对准大力。

“既然他不承认，不如由你来说。你若敢撒谎，这东西击穿的就不是你的手臂，而是你的脑袋！”

“我……我……”

大力看向秦昭岚手中的手枪，吓得脸色灰白。

张强咬了咬牙，转头看向他。

“大力，有话直说，不用受她威胁。有将军在，她不敢杀你！”

“你们将军的速度再快，能快得过子弹？”秦昭岚嘴角一挑，“不说实话，你们将军都救不了你！”

“大力，说实话！”

萧寒章看向大力，也很想知道真相。

大力看了看萧寒章，又转头看向张副将。

见他们都盯着自己，大力一咬牙，点头。

“一个多月前，我收到了一封写给秦夫人的信，交给了张副将。

如秦夫人所说的一样，张副将看完信，就把信烧了。”

Page (1/3)

Qin Zhaolan frowned.

It seems that conflict cannot be avoided today.

But since Xiao Hanzhang wants to take care of it, he should also be made to understand what his men did?

"General Xiao said that Zhang Qiang is one of your subordinates and you can't help but intervene in this matter. Well, I want to ask, your subordinates read my letter privately and burned it.

As a general, shouldn't you be fair and ask your subordinates to give me an explanation?"

"What, Vice General Zhang actually peeked at other people's letters!"

"Why did Vice General Zhang do what he did? Could it be that Vice General Zhang was going to attack her... Hehe..."

The soldier looked at Zhang Qiang, covered his mouth and snickered.

He didn't finish his words, but everyone else understood what he meant.

Zhang Qiang frowned and looked at him displeased.

"What nonsense are you talking about? How could I be interested in her?"

"Then Lieutenant General Zhang might as well tell you why you secretly read Mrs. Qin's letter and burned it?"

Xiao Hanzhang frowned, his face cold.

He actually didn't know that something like this happened in his military camp.

Zhang Qiang met his eyes and snorted coldly.

"What kind of letter? I don't know. General, don't believe this woman's words."

"Why, Vice General Zhang, do you dare to do this but don't you dare to admit it?"

Qin Zhaolan looked at him, his eyes full of ridicule.

She turned the hand holding the pistol and pointed the gun at Dali.

"Since he doesn't admit it, it's better for you to say it. If you dare to lie, this thing will penetrate not your arm, but your head!"

"I...I..."

Dali looked at the pistol in Qin Zhaolan's hand, his face turned pale with fear.

Zhang Qiang gritted his teeth and turned to look at him.

"Dali, say what you have to say without being threatened by her. She won't dare to kill you as long as the general is here!"

"No matter how fast your general is, can he be faster than a bullet?" Qin Zhaolan raised the corner of his mouth, "If you don't tell the truth, your general can't save you!"

"Dali, tell the truth!"

Xiao Hanzhang looked at Dali and wanted to know the truth.

Dali looked at Xiao Hanzhang, then turned to look at Deputy General Zhang.

Seeing them all staring at him, Dali gritted his teeth and nodded.

"More than a month ago, I received a letter addressed to Mrs. Qin and gave it to Vice General Zhang.

Just as Mrs. Qin said, Vice General Zhang burned the letter after reading it."
